verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own GPU-accelerated engines: a Windows native engine on Vulkan, a cross-vendor API that runs on NVIDIA and AMD GPUs, and an iOS app on Apple's MLX Swift. There is no NVIDIA- or AMD-specific kernel path, though: the CUDA backend is only a 'reserved slot', and Vulkan is vendor-agnostic rather than vendor-specific. Missing for 10: an implemented CUDA backend, any ROCm/AMD-specific kernels, documented per-vendor GPU support or benchmarks, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels

citations.quote: Windows: desktop app + native engine (C++ + Vulkan)
iOS: on-device iPhone app (Swift + MLX Swift)
a new backend implements the same facade (`backends/cuda/` is a reserved slot) with zero changes to core code
